name: Button
summary: Every act a person can take. Ink by default; attention only for the one verb that settles a wait.

variant.description: default = ink act; attention = the single verb that resolves a wait (max one per screen); outline = row actions and secondary choices; ghost = toolbars; destructive = a confirmed destructive act.

size.description: 32px (28px sm) at a desk; every size becomes 44px on phones.

asChild.description: Style the single child (e.g. an <a>) as the button instead of rendering <button>.

className.description: Extra classes, merged last with cn(); use token utilities only.

notes: size="icon" has no visible text: give it aria-label.
Focus is a 2px ring at a 2px offset; never remove it.
Disabled drops to 50% opacity and ignores pointer events.

do: Use variant="outline" for row actions and page tools.
Use variant="attention" only for the verb that settles a wait, once per screen.
Put a trailing arrow icon on go-acts.
dont: Don't render a raw <button> with hand-written classes.
Don't make a recommended option attention; a recommendation is not urgency.
Don't colour a failure with the accent; failure is destructive (vermilion).

examples.title: The one verb that settles a wait
